note: Spec 003 dedupe/anti-flood profiles. Most specific wins: mfrPid > driver > deviceClass > default. Leading edge always passes; windows only suppress identical repeats. Initial values aligned with in-repo windows already proven in the field (TuyaEF00Manager DP dedupe 500 ms / 750 ms for button-like DPs) and kept short; tune per device from reports (constitution M1). Opt-in: enabled=true activates runtime wiring (spec 003 T3); a device setting coordinator_mode on/off overrides. Button/remote: cross-channel-only press dedupe (same-channel repeats untouched, multi-click preserved), buttonCrossMs. collapseCommands=true collapses identical DP writes inside commandMs (off until a device report justifies it).
